.venv/bin/python -c "
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
import inspect
sig = inspect.signature(IsolationForest.__init__)
assert 'warm_start' in sig.parameters, 'warm_start not exposed'
assert sig.parameters['warm_start'].default is False
X = np.random.RandomState(0).randn(100, 4)
# warm start: fit 5, then grow to 8
clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=5, warm_start=True, random_state=0, behaviour='new', contamination='auto')
clf.fit(X)
n1 = len(clf.estimators_)
clf.set_params(n_estimators=8)
clf.fit(X)
n2 = len(clf.estimators_)
assert n1 == 5 and n2 == 8, (n1, n2)
# trees from first fit are reused (same objects)
# default warm_start=False refits from scratch
clf2 = IsolationForest(n_estimators=5, random_state=0, behaviour='new', contamination='auto')
clf2.fit(X)
assert len(clf2.estimators_) == 5
print('OK: warm_start exposed, default False, incremental fit 5->8 works')
"
